title: Error 503 Service Unavailable on the API gateway
solution: A 503 means the gateway could not reach a healthy upstream worker. 1) Check the worker pool on the status dashboard. 2) Restart unhealthy worker nodes with `nwctl workers restart --unhealthy`. 3) If more than 30% of workers are down, open a P1 incident.

title: Error 401 Unauthorized after rotating API keys
solution: Old keys stop working 15 minutes after rotation. Update the key in every service's secret store and redeploy. Check the clock on the client machine: tokens are rejected if the clock is more than 5 minutes off.

title: Error 429 Too Many Requests
solution: The default limit is 600 requests per minute per key. Add exponential backoff and respect the Retry-After header. Enterprise customers can request a higher limit through their account manager.

title: Database connection pool exhausted
solution: Raise `pool_size` from the default of 20 only after checking for leaked connections. Make sure every session is closed in a `finally` block. Long-running reports should use the read replica.

title: TLS certificate expired
solution: Certificates managed by Northwind renew automatically 30 days before expiry. For custom domains, upload the new certificate under Settings > Domains. Clients pinning the old certificate must be updated.

title: Slow dashboard loading
solution: Dashboards with more than 50 widgets load slowly. Split them into tabs. Clear the browser cache and check the status page for regional latency.

title: Webhook deliveries failing
solution: Webhooks are retried 5 times over 1 hour. Your endpoint must return a 2xx within 10 seconds. Check the delivery log under Settings > Webhooks for the exact error.

title: Billing: invoice shows the wrong plan
solution: Plan changes take effect at the next billing cycle. If you were charged for the wrong plan, the billing team can issue a prorated refund within 5 business days.
